items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 75:1
items.html: Since the Nukva of Atik took the GAR of Keter, which are the Guf and Atara of the ear, nothing remained for the Nukva of AA except from Gevura downward of the ear, for the Chesed of Bina always remains in Katnut in the GAR of Bina. Likewise ZON, which were nullified and fell into the Guf at the time of the breaking of the vessels, therefore remained lacking in Chassadim. Hence the male and female of AA stand in right and left, for the coupling of right and left indicates the bestowal of Chassadim, while the coupling of face and back indicates the bestowal of Chochma. (Inner Light, page 652, Sub Header, “Hence”)
